import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class E2MarekAndMatchingHardVersion {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        final int v;
        ModInt(int v) { this.v = (v % MOD + MOD) % MOD; }
        ModInt add(ModInt o) { return new ModInt((int)((long)v + o.v) % MOD); }
        ModInt subtract(ModInt o) { return new ModInt((int)((long)v - o.v + MOD) % MOD); }
        ModInt multiply(ModInt o) { return new ModInt((int)((long)v * o.v % MOD)); }
        ModInt divide(ModInt o) { return multiply(o.inverse()); }
        ModInt inverse() { return pow(MOD - 2); }
        ModInt pow(int e) {
            long r = 1, a = v;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (r * a) % MOD;
                a = (a * a) % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt((int)r);
        }
        int val() { return v; }
        static ModInt valueOf(int x) { return new ModInt(x); }
    }

    public void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
        int N = in.nextInt();
        int[][] P = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = in.nextInt();
            }
        }

        Map<BitSet, ModInt> G = new HashMap<>();
        BitSet initial = new BitSet(128);
        initial.set(0);
        G.put(initial, ModInt.valueOf(1));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Map<List<Integer>, ModInt> H = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<BitSet, ModInt> g : G.entrySet()) {
                BitSet bs = g.getKey();
                List<Integer> S = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); m++) {
                    if (bs.get(m)) S.add(m);
                }
                H.put(S, g.getValue());
            }
            G.clear();

            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                ModInt pst = ModInt.valueOf(1);
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        pst = pst.multiply(ModInt.valueOf(P[i][k]));
                    } else {
                        pst = pst.multiply(ModInt.valueOf(100 - P[i][k]));
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<List<Integer>, ModInt> h : H.entrySet()) {
                    BitSet ans = new BitSet(128);
                    List<Integer> list = h.getKey();
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; l++) {
                        if ((j & (1 << l)) == 0) continue;
                        for (int m : list) {
                            if ((m & (1 << l)) == 0) {
                                ans.set(m | (1 << l));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (!ans.isEmpty()) {
                        ModInt val = h.getValue().multiply(pst);
                        G.merge(ans, val, ModInt::add);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ModInt ans = ModInt.valueOf(0);
        for (ModInt v : G.values()) {
            ans = ans.add(v);
        }
        ModInt inv100 = ModInt.valueOf(100).inverse();
        ans = ans.multiply(inv100.pow(N * N));
        out.println(ans.val());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        new E2MarekAndMatchingHardVersion().solve(in, out);
        out.flush();
    }
}
